Watch this BOWL LOWERING with terrifying #tornado warned supercell near Show Low, Arizona!

Motorists in rental cars especially concerned.

This was day 2 of a major severe weather outbreak in Arizona.

I bet they wished they had the Terra Grappler G3s by @NittoTire https://t.co/XKA7v0evqf
A tornado warning has been issued for this anticyclonic mesocyclone west of Show Low, Arizona. We are in pursuit https://t.co/FAc4vtRTbv
As live from Alpine, Arizona chasing a supercell deep in the White Mountains. I may have botched this https://t.co/o5mjUSUZWe
Tornado warning has been issued for left-split supercell west of Silver City, NM. However, I am not concerned with the left split, but more the right mover east of Lordsburg https://t.co/rO8zZXITlh
Another #tornado warned supercell exiting the White Mountains west of Eager, Arizona with isolated gorilla hail scaring motorists in rental cars https://t.co/gvMtCZqqy5
The nicest weather in the USA today will be in and around Seattle, WA, Tucson, AZ, and Greensboro, NC. https://t.co/2KIhmCGEsE

From above, you can see where the flash flood went through Hurricane, Utah today. Red mud and water right through the neighborhoods.

Video: Landon Christensen https://t.co/ElPSOwtoKw

Arizona went 16 years without a tornado watch. Now it has had two in two days.

This one covers Flagstaff, Show Low, Safford and Sierra Vista until 8 PM Arizona time, and Gallup, Farmington and Silver City in New Mexico until 9 PM there. https://t.co/T5EfVgV7Bb

Arizona had 12 tornado warnings yesterday, the most in a day there since 2010.

Now Phoenix, Flagstaff, Prescott and Show Low are under severe storm watches until 10 and 11 AM Arizona time, with hail up to 2 inches possible. https://t.co/AHyYKRCuPz

Trick-or-treat forecast, 9 days out: most of y'all won't need a jacket over the costume.

Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas, keep an umbrella close. https://t.co/n8IidUpodI

New Mexico could see more severe weather today... large hail, damaging winds and even a tornado or two are possible as the storm system that has impacted Arizona the last two days slides east.

Storms will start firing over northern New Mexico and southern Colorado by early https://t.co/Y2v5fm5pya
THE PATRIOTS ARE BACK
Earlier this evening, southwest New Mexico had its first tornado warning in at least 40 YEARS for Grant and Hidalgo counties... https://t.co/Vb109F1k3A

Sizable CC drop too. Tornado is beginning to occlude.

You can track this on the @WxFront app. https://t.co/RGjzmVQEiE
Unwarned tornado near San Mateo, New Mexico, right now... https://t.co/wqKU8pNhI5
Large tornado earlier near Overgaard, Arizona, as seen from the StormNet app. 🌪️ #azwx https://t.co/al3LwTrsuv
Lightning is also likely, especially before hurricane Isaias goes extra-tropical. Here's the latest StormNet lightning forecast: https://t.co/rMWiW1FfJa

Hurricane Isaias is likely to bring the threat of tornadoes and lightning across the southeastern US.

See the latest StormNet tornado forecast for Isaias below, detailed hourly forecasts are available on the StormNet app and site. https://t.co/KkW3J5i7jW

A long-range threat of tornadoes and severe storms has been detected for Wednesday, October 14th, 2026.

This forecast initialized on Wednesday night (10/7). Follow this page and see the app for future forecast updates. https://t.co/LAFekKwBuA

Elevated threat of tornadoes detected for Sunday, October 11th, 2026.  

See attached map for details.  

This forecast initialized on Wednesday afternoon. Follow for future forecast updates. https://t.co/yygwgzVlJf

[Winter Preparedness] The NWS WSSI factors in both weather and infrastructure to rate storm severity on a simple 5-tier scale. Use standard WSSI (https://t.co/Vf81EI4Jz9) for 1–3 day forecasts and Probabilistic WSSI (https://t.co/chY7VFCQfq) to gauge risk up to 7 days out. 🌨️❄️ https://t.co/HTeakOi5G3
